claim: External effects are no longer refused by class. One inside a declared scope, using a verb that scope carries and leaving a receipt, proceeds without a further owner act; every refused verb stays refused.

visible_result.shows: the kernel and the ticket workflow refusing the same external effects by the same name, after the class refusal was lifted from SPEC.md and recompiled
visible_result.expect: PASS, 5 correspondences. The fact that used to read 'external-world effects are refused in this phase' now reads 'an external effect outside every declared scope is refused', and both sides still agree.

evidence.says: the amended effect-class clause: admitted inside a declared scope with a receipt, compensated forward, never claimed rolled back
two scopes (board metadata, branch writes on this repository) and ten verbs refused by name including force-push, merge, visibility, and secrets
K-013 unauthorized refused, K-017 authorized permitted, K-018 force-push refused inside a scope that exists
TC-015, TC-018, TC-019, TC-020, TC-021, TC-022: unauthorized, authorized, refused verb, no receipt, merge, invented scope
CONF-I5-DEF already fails any receipt claiming an external effect was rolled back; the compensation rule was contracted before this change and is unaltered by it

why_it_matters: The class refusal was doing two jobs: keeping irreversible acts behind an owner, and keeping ordinary board work behind one too. The second job is what left 44 issues and 7 pull requests unmanaged while agents were forbidden to touch them.
what_could_defeat_it: A scope whose named inverse verb does not actually undo the effect, which would make 'reversible' a label rather than a property.
An agent reaching a refused verb through some path the scope check does not cover, which would mean the boundary moved rather than narrowed.
An external effect whose receipt is written after the attempt rather than before, leaving a window where a failed write is indistinguishable from no write.
A future scope added without the same fixture discipline, which would let the list grow past what anyone has tested.
residuals: No adapter actually performs an authorized effect yet. This admits the effect; it does not build the crossing.
The receipt is named in the request and not yet written by anything, so the pre-write ordering above is unproven.
Scopes are hand-listed. There is no check that a scope's stated inverse verb is genuinely inverse.
This packet is presented by the seat that built it and is unwitnessed.
on_accept: STATUS.yaml protected_boundaries drops no_external_effects_in_phase_i for the four narrower boundaries; O7 and O16b move from holds to rulings.
on_reject: Revert SPEC.md line 57, the two contracts, and the six fixtures; the class refusal returns and the board stays unmanaged.
